prompt.description: The final, fully-composed image-generation prompt — ready to send straight to the image render provider. 3500 characters or fewer (same hard cap as the sibling vertical-drama-shot-start-frame-render skill; a downstream QC pass may still refine/compress it, but a well-written prompt should not rely on that fallback).

negative_prompt.description: The final negative prompt. Preserves the shot's existing negative-prompt content and adds any new negative terms this action's instructions require (e.g. anti-burned-in-text terms for multi_angle_grid).
